reason: I run a sit-down place because guests want a waiter who knows their name, not a phone on the table. I lost two waiters this year and I am not going to hand my floor to a screen that makes the room feel emptier.
objection: Will it work with my POS, or will my staff have to type orders in twice? And this is a brand-new company with no restaurants live yet, so I would be my own test case.
would_change_my_mind: A direct link to my POS so orders are not keyed in twice, plus a restaurant my size already running it for a few months that I can call and ask.
